title: Nature Whisper 22-in-1 Lion's Mane Mushroom Complex, 60 Capsules

comparisons.notes: Same 22-in-1 Lion's Mane mushroom complex with ashwagandha and black pepper; in stock

writeup: Nature Whisper's 22-in-1 complex pairs Lion's Mane with 19 other mushrooms plus ashwagandha and black pepper, in 60 vegan capsules. The brand says it's made in the USA and third-party lab tested. Its own store charges $13.99, and Woot has it new for $7.99.
